capabilities: Fetch YouTube captions automatically, manually, or via pasted transcript
Translate and summarize captions with Bedrock, OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini
Save genre-aware study notes with YAML frontmatter and embedded video
Bulk summarize multiple links, keeping failed links for retry
Auto-summarize new videos from subscribed channels once a day
disambiguation: Not a video downloader or speech-to-text tool; it only fetches YouTube captions and sends them to an AI provider.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+; AWS profile/SSO auth needs desktop runtime with Node.js 20+. API keys stored in Obsidian secret storage, not data.json; keys must be re-entered per device. No telemetry; cloud models incur provider usage fees; auto-summarize spends quota without per-run confirmation. Migrates settings and channels from earlier ID obsidian-youtube-summarizer.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull YouTube captions and turn videos into notes without external tools like yt-dlp or a separate summary server.
